english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for shouting loudly, especially in anger or excitement.
Choose 大嗌 for a person shouting loudly when the deep quality of the voice is supplied by context rather than by the verb.

examples.english: Everyone started to yell in the final minute.
examples.traditional: 最後一分鐘，大家都大嗌。
examples.jyutping: zeoi3 hau6 jat1 fan1 zung1 daai6 gaa1 dou1 daai6 aai3

examples.english: When they get angry, they bellow so loudly that the whole floor can hear them.
examples.traditional: 佢一嬲就大嗌，成層樓都聽到。
